title: An ample invertible module has a finite affine principal-open cover
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with an ample invertible $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Then there are finitely many integers $n_i>0$ and sections $s_i\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n_i})$ such that every $X_{s_i}$ is affine and $X=\bigcup_iX_{s_i}$.
